name: study-microbit-with-test
description: micro:bit 用方位磁石アプリケーション学習プロジェクト（ブロック・Python・TypeScript）

scripts.test: npm run test:config && npm run test:python && npm run test:ts && npm run test:makecode
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run integration:ts && npm run test:coverage
scripts.test:python: cd projects/sample-compass && uv run python -m pytest test/ -v --cov=compass_makecode --cov-report=term-missing
scripts.integration: npm run integration:python && npm run integration:ts
scripts.integration:python: cd projects/sample-compass && uv run python -m pytest test/test_simulator.py -v
scripts.lint: npm run lint:python && npm run lint:ts
scripts.lint:python: cd projects/sample-compass && uv run ruff check src/compass_makecode.py test/test_coverage.py
